faqs.a:
Pursuant to Title 31, Article 16, C.R.S. and the Arvada City Charter, the
2018 International Fire Code
, including Appendices B, D, E, F, G, H, I, K, L, and N published by the International
               Code Council is hereby adopted by reference thereto and incorporated into the Arvada
               City Code.
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
